summary.headline: Jupiter in the Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Jupiter placed in the houses of Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon, describing rulership, wealth, fame, noble connections, marriage, commerce, religion, and legal authority according to angularity and diurnal or nocturnal nativity.
